draft.emotion: friendly and anticipating, looking forward to a social interaction
notes: A godan verb (会います, 会って). The person you meet is marked with に (or と when mutual), never を: 友だちに会う (to meet a friend).
Do not confuse with the homophone 合う (あう, to fit or match).

senses.definition: To come together with someone in the same place, either by arrangement or by chance.

examples.translation: I met a friend at the station.
